== Selling ==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==

* {{PAGENAME}} is one of two units along with [[Blackhair]] that can curse enemies, making them take more magic damage.
* On update 20.0 , '''Shade Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow)''' can be evolved into [[Shadow Sorcerer (Incident)]].
** Along with [[Priest]] and [[Illusionist]], it has the most evolution form in the game.
